rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=2, train_n=400, n_iter=90, val_n=200, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.003, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, img_sr=0.0002, outer_wall_s=1150, seed=42, rationale=iter-16 dual_domain_bilateral_n2i, ONE-KNOB: n_iter 60->90 at optimal lr=3e-3 (iter-15 champion hr=0.2056 at n_iter=60). n_iter CURVE at gentle lr=3e-3: 30->0.1988, 60->0.2056 (rising). img_sr=0.0002, kernel=7, spatial=1.5 fixed. HYPOTHESIS: the gentle-lr regime is well-damped (no overshoot), so the per-scene edge-preserving fit keeps IMPROVING with more steps; 90 steps should push hr above 0.2056 IF the 6-param BF has not yet fully converged at 60. If FLAT/DROP, the tiny bilateral (6 params) has converged by ~60 steps and n_iter is saturated -> ~0.205 is the practical ceiling. WALL: n_iter60 trimmed val to 196 at outer_wall_s=900; n_iter90 is 1.5x more per-scene work so I RAISE outer_wall_s 900->1150 to keep val_n at/near 200 for a clean comparison (total still fits the 30-min=1800s sbatch wall: warm-start ~120s + 200x90 steps at breast-light 128-view adjoint + figure ~ under 1500s). Report val_n. ONE knob: n_iter 60->90 (outer_wall_s raised only to PRESERVE val_n, not as a second lever).
